column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for membership & spending records (e.g., 'MEM001').
An enum (MembershipType_enum) describing membership tier (Free, Basic, Diamond, Premium).
A SMALLINT capturing how many days the fan has been a member (e.g., 120).
An enum (SpendingFrequency_enum) for spending pattern (Occasional, Weekly, Monthly, Daily).
An enum (PaymentMethod_enum) indicating how the fan pays (Credit Card, Mobile Payment, PayPal, Crypto).
